name: Skeleton, Troll
body:
Huge skeletons with bones of giants reach their arms towards the flesh of the living

Troll Skeleton
CR 3

XP 800
NE Large undead (giant)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, –1 size)
hp 27 (6d8)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +5
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +8 (1d8+5), 2 claws +8 (1d6+5)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

TACTICS

Troll skeletons attack the closest target. They fight until destroyed.

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 16, Con —, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +10; CMD 23
Feats Improved InitiativeB

ECOLOGY

Environment any (typically created by magic)
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These skeletons are remnants of trolls dead long ago.
